edition_volume_count_needs_volume.name: edition_volume_count_needs_volume
edition_volume_count_needs_volume.value: "edition"."volume_count" is null or "edition"."volume" is not null

edition_volume_within_count.name: edition_volume_within_count
edition_volume_within_count.value: "edition"."volume_count" is null or "edition"."volume" is null or "edition"."volume" <= "edition"."volume_count"

work_series_position_end_check.name: work_series_position_end_check
work_series_position_end_check.value: "work_series"."position_end" is null or ("work_series"."position" is not null and "work_series"."position_end" > "work_series"."position")

user_work_rating_half_steps.name: user_work_rating_half_steps
user_work_rating_half_steps.value: "user_work"."rating" is null or ("user_work"."rating" between 0.5 and 5 and "user_work"."rating" * 2 = floor("user_work"."rating" * 2))
